# Data inventory

Lists every raw-derived data file with its size, row and column counts, date range, and each column's type and share of missing values. Rerun it after the data changes so it stays accurate.

*Generated by `src/01_download/reports/data_inventory.py`.*

Processed datasets in `data/processed/`.

| Dataset | Size on disk | Rows | Columns | Date range |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fresh_train` | 60.1 MB | 4,500,000 | 19 | 2024-03-28 to 2024-06-25 |
| `fresh_eval` | 5.4 MB | 350,000 | 19 | 2024-06-26 to 2024-07-02 |
| `favorita_food` | 86.3 MB | 11,284,633 | 9 | 2013-01-01 to 2017-08-15 |
| `dominicks_dept` | 9.2 MB | 324,133 | 9 | 1980-01-03 to 2009-06-11 |
